label: VERIFIED
extraction: Claude Code subagents are custom agents defined in .claude/agents/ with YAML frontmatter: name, description, tools (list), model (sonnet/opus/haiku), experimental.cacheTtl. Subagents run in isolated context, return summaries. Can invoke unlisted project/user/plugin skills via Skill tool. mcpServers field (no) specifies MCP servers available to subagent. Non-interactive mode and Agent SDK: set CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_DISABLE_BUILTIN_AGENTS=1 to remove built-ins. Name must be unique across .claude/agents/ tree. Frontmatter must be first line with --- delimiter. Tools list restricts available tools; omitting gives full access.
